thread:
Rae: Noticed an unexpected memory drift on kv-shard-21 during a nightly canary at ~23:10 UTC; two pods OOM'd by 23:12. Dash: https://metrics.internal/redwood/kv/shard-21/allocs Heap snapshot -> s3://redwood-infer/dumps/3265432100-shard21-heap.gz
Tom: Oncall 1: pausing canary and throttling prefetch concurrency to 30%. Can someone own triage and short-term mitigations?
Priya: I'll take triage. Quick pprof top shows retained bytes concentrated in 64k-256k slab buckets; stacks point to kv_prefetch.go:238 and alloc_map.reserveFast. Hypothesis: cancel path missing a release on the fast path.
Maya: Ops will add a temporary runtime guard `KV_MAX_RESIDENCY=100MB` to canary nodes and enable soft eviction. Scheduling a rolling restart to apply this tonight.
Rae: Uploaded a small pprof bundle and flamegraph to s3: s3://redwood-infer/profiles/3265432100-prioritized.tar.gz. Also: compare to INF-0987 notes; possible recurrence.
Priya: Plan: 1) run slab-scan to map freelist fragmentation and top stacks, 2) enable ms-resolution alloc sampling during a targeted repro, 3) attempt a small race fuzz that forces cancel vs reserve. ETA: initial findings in 36-48h. I'll include commit diffs if a regression is suspected.
Tom: I'll own monitoring and alerts. Adding threshold: page if shard residency > 90% of guard for 10m. Will mute noisy pages while guards in place.
Ops-Bot: Ticket INF-1500 created: "kv-shard-21 temporary residency guard + profiling" https://jira.internal/INF-1500 Assigned to Maya, due 2026-04-01.
Maya: Rolling restart initiated; will post status. Ops will also run slab-scan nightly for 2 nights and send a short digest here. Emergency flip commands will be in INF-1500 runbook.
Priya: Found candidate change in recent commit range: PR#922 touched reserveFast path; will include grep results and a minimal patch in the profiling report. Trying to produce a tiny repro now.
Rae: Action summary: - Priya: slab-scan + alloc sampling + repro (36-48h) - Maya/Ops: apply KV_MAX_RESIDENCY guard + nightly slab-scans (today + 2 nights) - Tom: monitoring and interim ownership (ongoing) - Rae: correlate with prior incidents and draft follow-up postmortem stub (72h).
Tom: If Priya's repro looks solid, let's plan a small safe patch with canary rollout. Schedule a 30min remediation sync once the profiling bundle lands.
Priya: Uploading first slab-scan: s3://redwood-infer/scans/3265432200-slab-hist.gz. Will post a concise write-up in 24h.
Maya: Rolling restart complete; canary reverted to stable rev. Health checks green. Monitoring window 45m.
Rae: Thanks. Keeping updates short here; full analysis will go into the postmortem doc after profiling. Next sync in 48h at 10:00 to review Priya's findings and decide timeline. Reopen this thread if we see regression. :eyes:
